nvitk.cli._common
=================

.. py:module:: nvitk.cli._common

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Shared Click options and local/SGE execution for module CLIs.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.cli._common.log

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: log

.. py:function:: backend_option(supports_gpu: bool = True)

   Add ``--backend cpu|gpu`` (default gpu) and apply it before the command runs.


.. py:function:: io_options(f)

   Attach the shared ``-i/--input`` and ``-o/--output`` Click options to *f*.


.. py:function:: mask_option(f)

   Attach an optional ``--mask`` Click option to *f*.


.. py:function:: submit_options(f)

   Attach the shared local/SGE submission Click options (``--submit``, ``--emit-script``,
   ``--direct-submit``, ``--no-remote``, ``--dry-run``) to *f*.


.. py:function:: run_local(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, *, backend: str = 'cpu', mask_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, runner: collections.abc.Callable[Ellipsis, Any], runner_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> pathlib.Path

   Read input, run tool, save output locally.


.. py:function:: run_sge(*, tool: str, subcommand: str, module_file: str, input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, backend: str = 'cpu', mask_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None = None, direct_submit: bool = False, no_remote: bool = False, dry_run: bool = False, extra_cli_args: list[str] | None = None) -> None

   Emit (and optionally submit) an SGE job script that runs *tool*'s *subcommand* worker on the
   cluster: builds the containerized worker command, writes the qsub script via
   :func:`~nvitk.cli._sge.emit_submit_script` (unless ``direct_submit`` skips straight to
   :func:`~nvitk.cli._sge.submit_tool_job`), and — unless ``no_remote``/``direct_submit`` — runs it
   over SSH on the configured cluster host if ``NVITK_SGE_SSH_*`` env vars are set.


.. py:function:: dispatch_tool(*, tool: str, subcommand: str, module_file: str, input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, submit: str, backend: str = 'gpu', mask_path: pathlib.Path | None, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, runner: collections.abc.Callable[Ellipsis, Any], runner_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None

   Route a tool invocation to either local execution (:func:`run_local`) or SGE submission
   (:func:`run_sge`) based on ``submit``, after activating the requested backend.
